patch_description: This crossover keeps the higher-performing nearest-neighbor CZ chain from the inspiration program while adopting the current program’s lower parameter count. Because RZ gates commute with CZ gates, the inspiration program’s parity-shared pre-RZ layer and independent post-RZ layer can be represented by one independent RZ layer without reducing the block’s effective single-qubit phase expressivity. This removes redundant gates and parameters, reducing circuit depth and optimization overhead while preserving the productive RY-plus-CZ-chain structure.
